texts: Male gender is a predictor of reoperative coronary bypass: B is the answer.
Younger, not older, age at the first operation predicts reoperation, because those patients live long enough for their grafts and native vessels to fail.
Use of an internal mammary artery graft protects against reoperation, and single-vessel disease and preserved functional status do not predict it.
Memory hook: the queue back to the operating table is all moustaches, while the lima vine walks out healthy.
